name: core.openwop.workflows.it-support
description: Real-work workflow pack (RFC 0013, ADR 0149, ADR 0208) — the IT / Support cluster: Incident Triage & Major-Incident Comms. An AI classifier assesses each incident's severity; routine incidents go to a recommended knowledge-base article and a ticket, while major incidents go to human-approved stakeholder updates in Slack — and each incident finishes with a post-incident summary. All tenant values are run parameters (replay-deterministic). Resolves on hosts shipping the kb + http + ai + chat + integration packs. Published under core.openwop.workflows.* (openwop-team key).
author: openwop
